target_customer: E-commerce retailers, marketplaces and developers needing structured product data
problem: Product catalog data across online retailers was messy and hard to access, so businesses lacked clean data on products and prices.
business_model: usage based data APIs and enterprise data and AI solutions

founders.name: Sivamani Varun
founders.background_notes: Later led engineering for the HRIS suite at Lattice (W16) and founded Keygraph, per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Crawling and normalizing product data at scale, plus matching and categorization models, which is standard but demanding engineering.

defensibility.rationale: A product database compounds with coverage, but crawling is copyable and retailers can change their pages.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Acquired later by Hearst Media according to the founder's YC bio; the date was not found.

market_need_then: Early descriptions say the company set out to track every product sold online and every price, offering retailers an API to that database, which fit growing demand for price and catalog data.

branding.community_and_virality: Product posts on Medium and a Matrix Partners viewpoint exist; nothing found about community.

brand_strength.rationale: A technical name tied to semantic data with blog and investor coverage, but no brand press found.

pivots.to: data and AI platform for e-commerce and cross-border logistics
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page and a Matrix Partners post show the later logistics positioning.

outcome_analysis: Semantics3 sold product data APIs and later pivoted to data and AI for e-commerce and cross-border logistics, reaching a team of about 25 per the YC page. The founder's bio says it was eventually acquired by Hearst Media, but no date, price or announcement was found, so the stage and size of the exit are unknown beyond a modest total raised.
notes: Funding unverified, aggregators only and conflicting: CB Insights 1.57M including a 1.55M bridge on 2015-11-05 (E-MERGE, Zillionize Angel, Y Combinator), PitchBook 2.15M, Wellfound 2.1M. None recorded as a round because no press or filing was opened. PitchBook says Out of Business, conflicting with the acquisition claim; the Matrix Partners page exists but was not opened. The company website did not resolve from this session so it could not be fetched. No competitor source was found, so the list is empty. Founding year differs: 2011 to 2012. Completeness pass: the 1.55M bridge of 2015-11-05 is recorded from CB Insights alone; totals of 2.1M to 2.2M elsewhere imply earlier unrecorded money.
